intent_summary: Forecast ordered calendar buckets through a validated public Python and JSON contract.

criteria.criterion: Complete zeros and signed measurements remain observations; partial tails preserve time and missing periods return unavailable without filling or compression.
criteria.notes: Reviewed complete/missing/partial validation and original-coordinate projection. New baseline keeps zero/signed observations and rejects missing history.

criteria.criterion: Forecasts use observations only, retain horizon prefixes and adjust only future learned trend changes; explicit recent-level-v1 compares smoothing against persistence on bounded chronological multi-step holdouts and retains persistence without supported improvement, independently of outlier policy.
criteria.notes: Reviewed bounded fixed candidate grid, original-coordinate chronological folds, one-step guard, multi-step MAE and persistence ties. Explicit models retain outputs; held-out evaluation includes both improvements and regressions.

criteria.criterion: Historical expectations and matching residual calibration use frozen prefix model and baseline selection; later observations cannot change earlier targets, with original indices and honest warmup and maturity preserved.
criteria.notes: Reviewed training-prefix selection before calibration, bounded prior-only references and residual rebuilding using that selected baseline. Both policies preserve point-time Expected and native points/patterns across changed/appended suffixes.

criteria.criterion: Results expose original indices, fit and inference windows, outlier policy effects and separate forecast applicability from anomaly maturity without confidence claims.
criteria.notes: Reviewed separate current/historical selection, params, fold losses, settings/fingerprints and original indices. Diagnostics describe policy selection, not health or accuracy.

criteria.criterion: Validated calendar inputs honor local calendar boundaries including DST and variable months; invalid, budget and numerical failures never return a completed partial forecast.
criteria.notes: Existing calendar and finite-result checks remain; new selection and historical prediction are bounded within cooperative runtime checks. Atomic unavailable behavior tested. Caller transport timeout remains necessary.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent self-review of the changed behavior and declared references; this is not independent delegated approval.
Python 3.12.9 full source suite: 435 passed in 58.73s with --basetemp=.tmp/pytest-080-release; default system TEMP denied access, so no product change was made for that environment issue.
After the reference-performance optimization and final bridge tests: 24 focused recent-level/evaluation tests passed in 8.66s, including exact equivalence to the existing robust reference policy.
Nested evaluation reproduces all 76 baseline/policy rows across 19 deterministic anonymous fixtures; losses for one stationary seed and a recent real step are retained.
Public demo, agentic demo, distribution demo and installed-API smoke checks passed. Private replay remained only in ignored .tmp and never entered published evidence.

Clean Python 3.12.9 wheel and sdist installs outside checkout passed Guard/forecast/native smoke, dependency/entry-point checks and all 56 native/recent-level regressions per artifact. Max-size bridge smoke covers both legacy and new baseline paths; tag CI must repeat on Linux.
remaining_gaps: Release 0.8.0 must pass tag CI on Python 3.11-3.13 and the offline Linux/Python 3.12 Lambda bundle before publication; local preflight does not certify publication.
Synthetic selection and retrospective local replay do not establish production accuracy. Separately validate UsageTap adoption and retain Current comparison/Guard provenance.
